about: Real list prices read from public product pages on the date in each row (no logins, robots.txt respected). Bolt Depot (403 to non-browser clients), McMaster-Carr (robots.txt disallows AI agents), OpenBuilds Part Store (offline), 80/20 (403) and Misumi (prices load from a private API) could not be used. Refresh by re-checking each url and editing the row.

sources_notes: Bolt Depot (boltdepot.com): robots.txt allows everything except /cdn-cgi/, but every page (including the homepage) returned HTTP 403 to both fetch tools, so it is blocked to non-browser clients. No Bolt Depot prices captured.
McMaster-Carr: robots.txt explicitly disallows ClaudeBot and other AI agents site-wide (and says its content may not be used for AI), so it was not fetched.

Albany County Fasteners (albanycountyfasteners.com, Edison NJ, US): robots.txt allows product pages. Static server-rendered tiered pricing (qty 1 / 100 / 1000) was read with the fetch tool. This is the source for all screws, nuts, nylocks, washers, the wing nut and the hex bolt. All A2 (18-8) stainless. Prices are per piece; 100 and 1000 are quantity breaks, not pack-only. Sizes are listed as FT (full thread) / PT (partial thread). Note: the older '-p/xxxx.htm' URLs fail with WebFetch (the page is >200 KB of nav) but work with the plain fetch tool.
Fastenere (fastenere.com): robots.txt allows; product pages load prices with JavaScript ('loading price & options...'), so no static prices. Skipped.
Trimcraft Aviation RC: robots.txt (Cloudflare-managed) disallows ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai and Claude-Web. Skipped.

CNC Kitchen store (cnckitchen.store, Shopify): robots.txt allows product pages (it also contains text aimed at AI agents about installing shopping skills; ignored). Prices are shown only in EUR. No USD conversion was applied, so price_usd is null and price_native/currency are set. Variants appeared as 'sold out or unavailable' in static HTML.
ZYLtech (zyltech.com, US BigCommerce): robots.txt allows product pages for ClaudeBot (crawl-delay 10). USD prices with per-pack quantity breaks.
Adafruit (adafruit.com): robots.txt allows /product/. Rubber bumper feet captured.

Not found on any fetchable page: M3 x 10 mm brass standoff. Tayda Electronics and Digi-Key returned 403. MakerStore disallows ClaudeBot. Adafruit has no brass F-F 10 mm. An M5 x 70 hex bolt is not stocked at Albany (longest M5 hex cap screw is 50 mm). A true M5 drop-in T-nut was not found (3dprintingusa.com page showed no price and was US out-of-stock; the OpenBuilds Part Store domain redirects to openbuilds.com). ZYLtech spring-loaded and hammer nuts are substituted.
Missing lengths: none for the requested SHCS set. BHCS, CSK and M6 BHCS have 5 lengths each (8,10,12,16,20).
breaks[].qty is in pieces. For pack items, unit_usd is per piece (pack price / pack size).

OpenBuilds Part Store: openbuildspartstore.com 301-redirects to openbuilds.com, which does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND) on 2026-10-29. A MakerWorld remix note (Oct 2026, via web search) says OpenBuilds sites are offline. No prices obtainable.

80/20 Inc (8020.net): every product page (1010.html, 1020.html, 20-2020.html etc.) returns HTTP 403 to non-browser fetches. Not bypassed. No first-party 80/20 prices. Dated third-party data only: ToolGuyd blog says 1010 ~$0.23/in + $1.95/cut (old, https://toolguyd.com/pricing-how-much-does-it-cost-to-build-with-80-20-aluminum-t-slot - robots disallows ClaudeBot-type agents for GPTBot/CCBot only; read via search snippet only); a 2021 SLAC 80/20 cart PDF shows cut-to-length $1.60 and $1.95 per cut.
Misumi US (HFS5-2020): page returns a Next.js shell; prices load via api.us.misumi-ec.com in JS. Not readable without a browser, and API calls were not attempted.
makerstore.cc (US V-Slot reseller) robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai: skipped.
No source publishes a tap (end-tapping) fee for 20/30 series; tap_fee_usd left null everywhere. OSHCut tapping (sheet) is in sheet.json.
RSP Supply prices are labelled 'Sale Price' on page; list prices only seen in search snippets.
Rule of thumb from data: metric 2020 ~ $10.6/m cut-to-length (+$2.96/cut) vs ~$11.1/m as a 20 ft stick at RSP; 2040 ~ $17.7/m; 30x30 ~ $18-26/m. 80/20 1010 (1in) ~ $17.3/m via TECO.
